findings.title: Conditional passkeys are no longer initialized for anonymous login
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())` returns false whenever no user has been selected. Consequently, the initial username/password page does not call `fillContextForm`, which is the call that sets `ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI`, creates/stores the WebAuthn challenge, and supplies the WebAuthn form attributes. This disables conditional/passkey authentication before a username is entered, defeating discoverable-passkey login. The same user-null guard in the error challenge path also removes passkeys after an invalid username submission. The pre-existing behavior intentionally initialized the conditional UI when passkeys were enabled even with no selected user; retain that behavior while additionally supporting the selected-user reauthentication case.
